Which submitted values were rejected and why, keyed by the name of the field they were submitted under. Carried by validation failures (`Validation`, status 422) and `null` for every other problem, as nothing else has a field to point at. The value of a key is either the list of failures on that field, each one a `code`, an optional `message` and the `params` the check was run with, or the same structure again for a nested object, or a map from index to that structure for a list. Nesting follows the shape of the submitted body and is therefore left free-form rather than modelled.
`_Kept` for backward compatibility, you should use `labels`_
